why: A delivers what the client described: a cognac distressed-leather sectional, a solid-wood coffee table on black steel and a black-metal-and-wood shelf, all suited to the beamed loft, though the shelf is low rather than a true bookcase and the rug leans strongly red. B misses on key pieces: a glossy dark sofa, an all-wood round table with no metal legs, and a glass shelving unit with no wood.
